theme: Landed in Dubrovnik — the Adriatic leg begins.
greeting: You made it to Dubrovnik, Dan. The Old Port apartment is yours for three nights, and the few loose ends worth closing are the ones that go dark once the boat swallows your signal on Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat arrangements
needsAttention.detail: You board Saturday and charter connectivity is poor to none. The Komolac to Cavtat transfer, the bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the early Sept 20 checkout all need arranging from dry land before Sept 12.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding
needsAttention.detail: Reach the sailing instructor to pin Saturday's exact boarding time and place, and to set up the Sept 19 airport transfer. The packet says sort it early — easier now than once you are underway.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 SUV
needsAttention.detail: This one is no longer a hedge — the Pathfinder cannot be in Florida before Oct 18, so the rental is certain. Full-size SUV out of TPA, Sept 20 to Oct 5, ideally refundable.

needsAttention.title: Send Kerrie the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: After you sent the whistleblower document, Kerrie Waring wrote back asking for the AI governance paper you had referenced. A quick send closes the loop.

flagged.title: Clarke Customer Care invoice
flagged.detail: An invoice for the July 31 appliance repair is marked due — worth a glance so it does not linger while you travel.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Yvonne
flagged.detail: A new LinkedIn message is sitting unanswered — likely networking, worth a look when you have a moment.

flagged.title: Valoris and Nomura thread still live
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano is lining up Mercer contacts for Chie Mitsui and still wants a call with you when there is time.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel plumbing — Airbnb and Booking.com confirmations, boarding passes, and card receipts.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell call deferred
resolved.detail: Carol reconnected wanting to talk; you offered today, and she replied to enjoy the sailing and pick it up once you are back after the 19th.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are at their crisp, tart best right now — perfect for baking down into something warm.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20 to 22 landing gap

acts.line: Two flights carried you off the overnight from Tampa and down through Frankfurt to the coast.
You touched down in Dubrovnik and settled into the apartment above the Old Port.
The city is quiet and yours tonight; the Nautilus charter and Cavtat are still days out.
